at åbne.explanation: "At åbne" means "to open". You can open a door, a shop or a bank account. Hvornår åbner I? (When do you open?) is what you ask a shop or office.

sentence.en: I want to open the door for you.

at åbne op.explanation: "At åbne op" means "to open up": Hun åbner op om sine følelser (She opens up about her feelings). It also fits shops: Butikken åbner op klokken ni (The shop opens at nine).

sentence.da: Kan du **åbne op**? Jeg står udenfor.
sentence.en: Can you open up? I am standing outside.

en å.explanation: "En å" means "a stream", a small river: Vi går langs åen (We walk along the stream). Do not mix it up with en flod (a bigger river): Floden er bredere (The river is wider).

sentence.da: Vi gik en tur langs den smalle **å**.
sentence.en: We took a walk along the narrow stream.

en åbning.explanation: "En åbning" means "an opening", a gap or the start of something: en åbning i hegnet (an opening in the fence). It is also the opening of a shop or event: Vi går til åbningen (We are going to the opening).

sentence.da: Katten fandt en lille **åbning** i hegnet.
sentence.en: The cat found a small opening in the fence.

en åbningstid.explanation: "En åbningstid" means "an opening hour". Danes usually say it in the plural when they ask when a shop is open: Hvad er butikkens åbningstider? (What are the shop's opening hours?)

sentence.da: Jeg kender ikke butikkens **åbningstid** i dag.
sentence.en: I do not know the shop's opening hours today.

en årsag.explanation: "En årsag" means "a reason", the cause of something that happened: Hvad er årsagen? (What is the reason?). For a reason to do something, en grund (a reason) is more common.

sentence.da: Der må være en **årsag** til, at bilen ikke starter.
sentence.en: There must be a reason why the car does not start.

en årstid.explanation: "En årstid" means "a season", one of the four parts of the year: Det er en kold årstid (It is a cold season). Do not mix it up with en sæson (a season of a show or sport): Sæsonen starter i dag (The season starts today).

sentence.en: Which season do you like best?

et åbent hus.explanation: "Et åbent hus" means "an open house", an event where anyone can come and look around: Skolen holder åbent hus i morgen (The school has an open house tomorrow). It is used for schools, companies and homes for sale.

sentence.en: The school has an open house on Saturday.

et år.explanation: "Et år" means "a year". It is also how you give your age: Jeg er tredive år gammel means "I am thirty years old". Næste år means "next year".

sentence.da: Der er tolv måneder i et **år**.
sentence.en: There are twelve months in a year.

et århundrede.explanation: "Et århundrede" means "a century", a hundred years. It is built from år (year) and hundrede (hundred): Huset er fra det nittende århundrede (The house is from the nineteenth century).

sentence.en: The house is almost a century old.

et årstal.explanation: "Et årstal" means "a year", the number that names a year, like 1990: Jeg kan ikke huske årstallet (I can't remember the year). For a length of time, use et år: tre år (three years).

sentence.en: Which year was the house built?

åben.explanation: "Åben" means "open", for doors, shops and windows: Døren er åben (The door is open). At åbne (to open) is the action: Jeg åbner døren (I open the door).

sentence.en: The shop is open until six o'clock.

åbenbart.explanation: "Åbenbart" means "apparently" and is used when you work something out from what you see or hear: Du har åbenbart glemt det (You apparently forgot it). Compare tydeligvis (clearly), which sounds more sure.

åbningstider.explanation: "Åbningstider" means "opening hours": Hvad er jeres åbningstider? (What are your opening hours?). It is built from åbning (opening) and tider (times).

sentence.da: Butikkens **åbningstider** er fra ni til seks.
sentence.en: The shop's opening hours are from nine to six.

årlig.explanation: "Årlig" means "annual", something that happens once a year: Det er en årlig tradition (It is an annual tradition). Det sker årligt (It happens every year) says how often.

sentence.da: Vi har en **årlig** fest i juni.
sentence.en: We have an annual party in June.
